findings.claim: The generator hunks add new Error-severity diagnostics MsgPack019-022, but the diff does not show them being added to AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md or to docs, which `doc/analyzers` and the help links reference. Missing release tracking triggers RS2000 and fails the build, and the help-link docs pages would 404.

receipt_plan.detail: Check that src/MessagePack.SourceGenerator/AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md lists MsgPack019-022 and that doc/analyzers/MsgPack019.md through MsgPack022.md exist. No hunk in this change touches them.

findings.claim: The new template emits `partial class` for user-declared formatters, but the Info.Formatter name and its nesting and namespace come from QualifiedNamedTypeName(formatter) and EmitNestingTypesAndNamespaces. If the user's partial class is `public` or `sealed`, or if it is nested, the generated partial can only carry compatible modifiers because C# merges modifiers. The existing sealed/internal path is untouched, so non-annotated types are unaffected. Separately, generated resolver code may reference the user formatter by name. If the formatter class is private nested or has constructor requirements, the resolver registration could fail to compile or fail to instantiate it.

receipt_plan.detail: Snapshot-test a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] class that is nested, private and public sealed. Compile the generated output including the resolver and confirm it builds.

findings.claim: The analyzer diagnostics for the new attribute are reported only from the generator via RegisterSourceOutput. Even so, the existing hand-written-formatter discovery in GeneratorUtilities now skips attributed classes by comparing ToDisplayString to the attribute name. In a project that already declares its own `MessagePack.GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute`, the behavior would change silently. Beyond that, any existing user class already named `GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute` in the MessagePack namespace is now treated specially. This is a very narrow edge case.

receipt_plan.detail: Read GeneratorUtilities.cs:38. The check compares only the display string, with no assembly check.
